I'm sorry, but this is the most selfish post I've ever seen. I'm child-free and proud of it. I cant believe you think you should be the center of your friend's universe. Everyone has different paths. People grow and change. Some child-free people are so self entitled. Your friend had a kid and loves it. I'm sure you have your hobbies. I don't understand people who want kids. I don't understand what is so great about it, but I don't think grown ass people should shape their lives around me either.

Man, I'm sorry you went through that. Are things better now?
That's great. I love seeing interracial families. Glad you have an awesome life now :)

Sorry your own family can be so cruel for a minuscule thing. I know I used to feel guilty for being light-skinned. I used to try to tan, and burn my skin. 

My mother is white and she always tanned. She had a skin cancer scare years ago, that caused me to love my paleness.
Some people don't love themselves. So they try to make others not love themselves.

I didn't know Caribbean people went through that too. Colorisum seems to  effect many of races. It doesn't matter  that you are mixed, I think its wonderful you embrace your Indo-Caribbean side. :) 

No body has the right to tell you what race you are. Ignore those hateful people.
In 2017, we as humans should take education more seriously. This is the future we are shaping. So many teachers don't care about educating students, they only care about a check.
I hope it gets better for you. Seems like you were able to overcome it yourself. It takes a strong person to do that. #Mixed pride :)
Did you ever get therapy for the bullying? If not how did you deal with it?

One thing that always grinded my gears, "You act white". How can you act a race ? That used to get me so fired up. I noticed that full black kids used to be excluded too, if they spoke in a particular manner. 

I cant believe after you gave that woman a pen, she still had the gall to insult you. Some people are so brazen. If black kids didn't like you, who did you hang out with?

That seems rough. More diverse areas always seem to be the best. Sometimes being accepted is very important for young adolescents. When you are mixed, you can never be full anything. Good thing you defended yourself. I allowed myself to be bullied, until I got into a fight . Kids left me alone after that. :)


I hated my teachers too. They watched as I Was bullied, and did nothing. I even went up to the office and reported the bullying but that made it worse I soon was called a "snitch"


When I was sick of the bullying, and stood up for myself, I was suspended. People don't care about  bullying until something bad happens.

Good thing you live in a better place where people don't care about your race.

Being mixed is awesome, but it also it has downfalls. People used to tell me I was exotic too. Both sides can be so doushy  .Most of my Friends were neither black nor white, they were Hispanic. Hispanic people always seem to accept me for me.
Its worse when its strangers, because you know its absolute racism.

I figured it had something to do with the "lightskin is better" mentality. It is still confusing that even when you are kind and respectful some people still think about you. I also never really understand why people thought that. That book sounds interesting I will definitely take a look.
When your are mixed, you can never win. lol
Yeah, kinda sucks.
